name: storyarc
description: Monorepo tooling for StoryArc — native comic, manga and ebook readers for iOS and Android.

scripts.lint: pnpm lines:check && pnpm tokens:check && pnpm brand:check && pnpm spec:validate && pnpm spec:guard && pnpm delta:drop && pnpm partial:tasks && pnpm ios:ci:check && pnpm preview:proof && pnpm openspec:workflows:check && pnpm tokens:verify && pnpm fixtures:check && pnpm notices:check && pnpm libarchive:pin && pnpm lockfile:ios && pnpm corpus:check && pnpm kavita:check && pnpm opds:check && pnpm strings:ios && pnpm strings:drawn && pnpm live:check:selftest && pnpm commitlint:guard
scripts.test:ios: cd apps/ios/Packages/StoryArcKit && swift test; status=$?; node ../../../../scripts/sweep-test-debris.mjs || true; exit $status
scripts.test:ios:epub: cd apps/ios/Packages/StoryArcEpub && mkdir -p ../../../../.build/xcresult && rm -rf ../../../../.build/xcresult/epub.xcresult && xcodebuild test -scheme StoryArcEpub -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro,OS=latest' -collect-test-diagnostics never -resultBundlePath ../../../../.build/xcresult/epub.xcresult -quiet
scripts.test:ios:ui: cd apps/ios && mkdir -p ../../.build/xcresult && rm -rf ../../.build/xcresult/ui.xcresult && xcodebuild test-without-building -project StoryArc.xcodeproj -scheme StoryArc -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath ../../.build/ios-ui -only-testing:StoryArcUITests -collect-test-diagnostics never -resultBundlePath ../../.build/xcresult/ui.xcresult -quiet
scripts.//why: A run with -quiet prints the failing test names, TEST FAILED and exit code 65. It prints no assertion message, no expected value and no actual value. These two scripts read the assertion text out of the result bundle that test:ios:ui and test:ios:epub write. Run the matching script after a test script fails.
scripts.build:ios: cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild build -project StoryArc.xcodeproj -scheme StoryArc -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -quiet
scripts.build:ios:tests: cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild build-for-testing -project StoryArc.xcodeproj -scheme StoryArc -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -quiet
scripts.selftests: pnpm openspec:workflows:selftest && pnpm libarchive:pin:selftest && pnpm lockfile:ios:selftest && pnpm a11y:selftest && pnpm strings:drawn:selftest && pnpm release:selftest && pnpm preview:proof:selftest && pnpm png:selftest && pnpm capture:compare:selftest
scripts.//check: Tier 1. This tier needs no simulator and no emulator. It stands for these CI jobs: Contract / Specs and design tokens; iOS / StoryArcKit; iOS / SwiftLint; iOS / App, its Build step only; Android / Lint, test and assemble. pnpm selftests holds the nine Contract self-test steps that pnpm lint leaves out.
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm selftests && pnpm lint:ios && pnpm test:ios && pnpm build:ios:tests && pnpm lint:android && pnpm test:android && pnpm build:android && pnpm build:android:tests
scripts.//check:devices: Tier 2. This tier needs a booted iPhone 17 Pro simulator and a running Android emulator. It takes minutes. It stands for these CI jobs: iOS / StoryArcEpub; iOS / App, its Accessibility audit step; Android / Instrumented tests. A green pnpm check proves none of these three. Run this tier before you change a UI test, a format decoder or the epub reader.
scripts.check:devices: pnpm test:ios:epub && pnpm build:ios:ui && pnpm seed:ios:ui && pnpm test:ios:ui && pnpm test:android:instrumented
scripts.//strings:divergence: A report, not a gate, and deliberately outside pnpm lint: a row it prints can be a difference the platform forces. Run it when a value changes on one platform.
scripts.brand:check: if [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ]; then swift scripts/brand-mark.swift --out . --check; else echo 'brand:check: skipped. The generator imports CoreGraphics and ImageIO, which exist only on Apple platforms. The iOS workflow runs it on macOS.'; fi
scripts.build:ios:ui: cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild build-for-testing -project StoryArc.xcodeproj -scheme StoryArc -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath ../../.build/ios-ui -quiet
